name: @gleanwork/glean-indexing-sdk-agent-plugin
description: Agent plugin sources for building Glean Indexing SDK connectors.

scripts.validate:plugins: pluginpack validate --target claude --dir . && pluginpack validate --target cursor --dir . && pluginpack validate --target codex --dir .
scripts.diff:plugins: pluginpack diff --target claude --against . && pluginpack diff --target cursor --against . && pluginpack diff --target codex --against .
scripts.test:plugins: npm run build:plugins && npm run validate:plugins
